parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays on chembl_id = CHEMBL1794523. Join activities on assay_id. Join molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno. Filter where standard_relation = '=' and standard_value is not null and standard_relation is not null. Return all matching rows.
